SELECT 
    rd.loan_id,
    rd.as_of_date
FROM 
    risk_classification rd
JOIN 
    classification_grade cg ON rd.grade_code = cg.grade_code
WHERE 
    cg.grade_name_zh = '次级'
ORDER BY 
    rd.loan_id ASC;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.disbursed_amount
FROM 
    main.loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    main.status_catalog sc ON ld.status = sc.status_code
WHERE 
    sc.entity = 'loan_drawdown'
    AND sc.name_zh = '已核销';

SELECT 
    pe.payment_id,
    pe.business_date,
    pe.amount
FROM 
    payment_event pe
JOIN 
    payment_type_catalog ptc ON pe.payment_type = ptc.payment_type
WHERE 
    ptc.name_zh = '现金支取'
    AND pe.amount > 5000000
ORDER BY 
    pe.amount DESC;

SELECT p.party_id, pp.annual_income
FROM party p
JOIN person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
JOIN party_type_catalog ptc ON p.party_type = ptc.party_type
WHERE ptc.name_zh = '个人客户'
  AND pp.annual_income > 1000000
ORDER BY pp.annual_income DESC;

SELECT 
    pc.card_id,
    pc.issued_on,
    pc.expires_on
FROM 
    payment_card pc
JOIN 
    card_type_catalog ctc ON pc.card_type = ctc.card_type
WHERE 
    ctc.name_zh = '贷记卡'
ORDER BY 
    pc.issued_on ASC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    op.operating_status
FROM 
    party p
JOIN 
    organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
JOIN 
    organization_unit ou ON op.registered_region = ou.region_code
JOIN 
    party_type_catalog ptc ON p.party_type = ptc.party_type
WHERE 
    ou.unit_name = '上海分行'
    AND ptc.name_zh = '对公客户'
ORDER BY 
    p.party_id ASC;

SELECT i.institution_name, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM institution i
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
JOIN loan_drawdown l ON ca.agreement_id = l.agreement_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY loan_count DESC;

SELECT 
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(a.account_id) AS account_count
FROM 
    organization_unit ou
JOIN 
    account a ON ou.org_unit_id = a.org_unit_id
GROUP BY 
    ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY 
    account_count DESC;

SELECT 
    isct.sector_name_zh AS industry_name,
    SUM(ca.contract_amount) AS total_contract_amount
FROM 
    credit_agreement ca
JOIN 
    party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
JOIN 
    industry_sector isct ON op.industry_code = isct.sector_code
JOIN 
    party_type_catalog ptc ON p.party_type = ptc.party_type
WHERE 
    ptc.name_zh = '对公客户'
GROUP BY 
    isct.sector_name_zh
ORDER BY 
    total_contract_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    wp.product_name,
    SUM(phs.carrying_amount) AS total_market_value
FROM 
    wealth_product wp
JOIN 
    product_holding_snapshot phs ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
GROUP BY 
    wp.product_id, wp.product_name
ORDER BY 
    total_market_value DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(pr.relation_id) AS relation_count
FROM 
    party_relation pr
JOIN 
    party p ON pr.source_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    organization_unit ou ON p.home_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
GROUP BY 
    ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY 
    relation_count DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    cs.net_capital,
    cs.risk_weighted_assets
FROM 
    capital_snapshot cs
JOIN 
    institution i ON cs.institution_id = i.institution_id
ORDER BY 
    cs.net_capital DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    SUM(abs.ledger_balance) AS total_deposit_balance
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    main.account a ON i.institution_id = a.institution_id
JOIN 
    main.account_balance_snapshot abs ON a.account_id = abs.account_id
WHERE 
    a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 
    total_deposit_balance DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    AVG(ds.principal_overdue_days) AS avg_overdue_days
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    delinquency_snapshot ds ON ds.loan_id = ld.loan_id
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.in!institution_name
HAVING 
    AVG(ds.principal_overdue_days) > 90
ORDER BY 
    avg_overdue_days DESC;

SELECT 
    eg.exposure_group_id AS group_id,
    eg.group_name,
    SUM(COALESCE(lbs.principal_balance, 0)) AS total_exposure,
    (SUM(COALESCE(lbs.principal_balance, 0)) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital) AS exposure_ratio
FROM 
    exposure_group eg
JOIN 
    exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
JOIN 
    party p ON egm.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN 
    loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN 
    institution i ON eg.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN 
    capital_snapshot cs ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id
WHERE 
    lbs.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM loan_balance_snapshot WHERE loan_id = lbs.loan_id)
    AND cs.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM capital_snapshot WHERE institution_id = i.institution_id)
GROUP BY 
    eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name, cs.net_capital
ORDER BY 
    exposure_ratio DESC;

WITH industry_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        op.industry_code,
        COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS total_loan_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN cg.grade_name_zh IN ('次级', '可疑', '损失') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS npl_count
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN organization_profile op ON ca.borrower_party_id = op.party_id
    LEFT JOIN risk_classification rc ON ld.loan_id = rc.loan_id
    LEFT JOIN classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
    GROUP BY op.industry_code
    HAVING COUNT(ld.loan!id) >= 20
)
SELECT 
    isec.sector_name_zh AS industry_name,
    il.total_loan_count AS loan_count,
    il.npl_count AS npl_count,
    (il.npl_count * 1.0 / il.total_loan_count) AS npl_ratio
FROM industry_loans il
JOIN industry_sector isec ON il.industry_code = isec.sector_code
ORDER BY npl_ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id AS customer_id,
    p.display_name AS customer_name,
    SUM(ca.contract_amount) AS total_contract_amount
FROM 
    party p
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
GROUP BY 
    p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY 
    total_contract_amount DESC
LIMIT 15;

SELECT 
    risk_level, 
    COUNT(*) AS product_count, 
    AVG(management_fee_rate) AS avg_management_fee_rate
FROM 
    wealth_product
GROUP BY 
    risk_level
ORDER BY 
    risk_level ASC;

SELECT 
    gc.guarantor_party_id AS "担保人编号",
    p.display_name AS "担保人名称",
    SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) AS "在保余额合计"
FROM 
    main.guarantor_commitment gc
JOIN 
    main.party p ON gc.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE 
    gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND (gc.effective_to IS NULL OR gc.effective_to >= DATE('now'))
GROUP BY 
    gc.guarantor_party_id, p.display_name
HAVING 
    SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) > 500000000
ORDER BY 
    SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) DESC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id AS customer_id,
    p.display_name AS customer_name,
    SUM(ca.contract_amount) * 1.0 AS total_contract_amount
FROM 
    party p
JOIN 
    party_relation pr ON p.party_id = pr.source_party_id
JOIN 
    relation_type_catalog rtc ON pr.relation_type = rtc.relation_type
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
WHERE 
    rtc.relation_name_zh != '非关联方'
GROUP BY 
    p.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING 
    SUM(ca.contract_amount) > 300000000
ORDER BY 
    total_contract_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(*) AS record_count,
    SUM(d.observed_value) AS total_observed_value
FROM 
    data_security_event_v3 d
JOIN 
    institution i ON d.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN 
    regulatory_event_catalog c ON d.event_code = c.event_code
WHERE 
    c.rule_family = '数据安全'
    AND d.exception_flag = 1
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 
    total_observed_value DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(*) AS overdue_count
FROM 
    regulatory_submission_event_v3 r
JOIN 
    institution i ON r.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN 
    regulatory_event_catalog c ON r.event_code = c.event_code
WHERE 
    c.rule_family = '监管报送'
    AND (r.completion_date IS NULL OR r.completion_date > r.deadline_date)
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(*) >= 20
ORDER BY 
    overdue_count DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    (cs.net_capital * 1.0 / cs.risk_weighted_assets) AS capital_adequacy_ratio
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    capital_snapshot cs ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id
WHERE 
    cs.risk_weighted_assets > 0
ORDER BY 
    capital_adequacy_ratio ASC;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id,
    ds.principal_overdue_days,
    cg.grade_name_zh,
    rc.as_of_date
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    delinquency_snapshot ds ON ld.loan_id = ds.loan_id
JOIN 
    risk_classification rc ON ld.loan_id = rc.loan_id
JOIN 
    classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
WHERE 
    ds.principal_overdue_days > 90
    AND cg.grade_name_zh IN ('正常', '关注')
    AND rc.as_of_date = (
        SELECT MAX(rc_inner.as_of_date)
        FROM risk_classification rc_inner
        WHERE rc_inner.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    )
ORDER BY 
    ds.principal_overdue_days DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS insufficient_provision_loan_balance
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN 
    provision_snapshot ps ON ps.loan_id = ld.loan_id AND ps.as_of_date = lbs.as_of_date
WHERE 
    ps.required_amount > ps.recognized_amount
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING 
    SUM(lbs.principal_balance) > 100000000
ORDER BY 
    insufficient_provision_loan_balance DESC;

SELECT 
    pi.instruction_id,
    ld.loan_id,
    p.display_name AS payee_name,
    isec.sector_name_zh,
    pi.instruction_amount
FROM 
    payment_instruction pi
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON pi.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN 
    party p ON pi.intended_payee_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
JOIN 
    industry_sector isec ON op.industry_code = isec.sector_code
WHERE 
    pi.status = 'EXECUTED'
    AND isec.risk_category IN ('RESTRICTED', 'EXIT')
ORDER BY 
    pi.instruction_amount DESC;

WITH restricted_industries AS (
    SELECT sector_code
    FROM industry_sector
    WHERE risk_category IN ('限制类', '退出类')
),
instruction_amounts AS (
    SELECT
        i.institution_id,
        i.institution_name,
        pi.instruction_amount,
        CASE
            WHEN op.industry_code IN (SELECT sector_code FROM restricted_industries) THEN pi.instruction_amount
            ELSE 0.0
        END AS restricted_amount
    FROM payment_instruction pi
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON pi.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN organization_profile op ON ca.borrower_party_id = op.party_id
    JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
    WHERE pi.intended_payee_party_id IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    institution_name,
    SUM(restricted_amount) AS violation_inflow_amount,
    SUM(instruction_amount) AS total_instruction_amount,
    SUM(restricted_amount) * 1.0 / SUM(instruction_amount) AS ratio
FROM instruction_amounts
GROUP BY institution_id, institution_name
ORDER BY ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    wp.product_id,
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_id,
    ma.maturity_on AS asset_maturity_date,
    wp.actual_termination_on AS product_termination_date
FROM 
    wealth_product wp
JOIN 
    product_holding_snapshot phs ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
JOIN 
    managed_asset ma ON phs.asset_id = ma.asset_id
WHERE 
    ma.maturity_on > wp.actual_termination_on
ORDER BY 
    ma.maturity_on DESC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT gc.commitment_id) AS guarantee_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca.agreement_id) AS borrower_count
FROM 
    party p
JOIN 
    guarantor_commitment gc ON p.party_id = gc.guarantor_party_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
GROUP BY 
    p.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(DISTINCT gc.commitment_id) > 0 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ca.agreement_id) > 0
ORDER BY 
    guarantee_count DESC;

SELECT 
    pe.payment_id,
    pe.business_date,
    ptc.name_zh AS payment_type_name_zh,
    pe.amount,
    ou.unit_name AS org_unit_name
FROM 
    payment_event pe
JOIN 
    payment_type_catalog ptc ON pe.payment_type = ptc.payment_type
JOIN 
    organization_unit ou ON pe.origin_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
JOIN 
    status_catalog sc ON pe.status = sc.status_code AND sc.entity = 'payment_event'
WHERE 
    pe.is_cash = 1
    AND pe.amount > 5000000.0
    AND sc.name_zh = '已清算'
ORDER BY 
    pe.amount DESC;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id,
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    op.legal_form AS borrower_registered_industry,
    is_sec.sector_name_zh AS agreement_target_industry,
    ca.contract_amount
FROM 
    credit_agreement ca
JOIN 
    party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
JOIN 
    industry_sector is_sec ON ca.target_industry_code = is_sec.sector_code
WHERE 
    op.industry_code IS NOT NULL 
    AND ca.target_industry_code IS NOT NULL
    AND op.industry_code != ca.target_industry_code
ORDER BY 
    ca.contract_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    pe.payment_id,
    pe.business_date,
    pe.amount,
    ah_from.party_id AS from_customer_id,
    ah_to.party_id AS to_customer_id
FROM 
    payment_event pe
JOIN 
    account_holder ah_from ON pe.from_account_id = ah_from.account_id
JOIN 
    account_holder ah_to ON pe.to_account_id = ah_to.account_id
JOIN 
    party_relation pr ON ah_from.party_id = pr.source_party_id AND ah_to.party_id = pr.target_party_id
JOIN 
    relation_type_catalog rtc ON pr.relation_type = rtc.relation_type
WHERE 
    ah_from.holder_role = 'PRIMARY' 
    AND ah_to.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
    AND rtc.relation_name_zh != '非关联方'
    AND pe.status = 'SETTLED'
ORDER BY 
    pe.amount DESC;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id,
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM 
    credit_agreement ca
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN 
    party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
GROUP BY 
    ca.agreement_id, p.display_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) >= 3
ORDER BY 
    loan_count DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
    SUM(pe.amount) AS total_amount
FROM 
    payment_event pe
JOIN 
    account a ON pe.from_account_id = a.account_id OR pe.to_account_id = a.account_id
JOIN 
    institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE 
    pe.is_cash = 1
    AND pe.amount > 5000000
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(*) >= 50
ORDER BY 
    total_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    sm.staff_id,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM 
    staff_member sm
JOIN 
    payment_event pe ON sm.home_org_unit_id = pe.origin_org_unit_id
JOIN 
    account acc ON pe.to_account_id = acc.account_id
JOIN 
    account_holder ah ON acc.account_id = ah.account_id 
    AND ah.effective_to IS NULL
JOIN 
    party p ON ah.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
JOIN 
    industry_sector isec ON op.industry_code = isec.sector_code
WHERE 
    isec.risk_category IN ('RESTRICTED', 'EXIT')
GROUP BY 
    sm.staff_id
ORDER BY 
    transaction_count DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
    cdd.record_id,
    i.institution_name,
    cdd.event_date,
    cdd.deadline_date,
    CAST(julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(cdd.deadline_date) AS INTEGER) AS days_overdue
FROM 
    customer_due_diligence_event_v3 cdd
JOIN 
    institution i ON cdd.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE 
    cdd.event_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND cdd.completion_date IS NULL
ORDER BY 
    days_overdue DESC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT 
    sa.security_id,
    cl.collateral_id,
    ca.status AS collateral_status,
    sa.status AS security_status
FROM 
    security_agreement sa
JOIN 
    collateral_link cl ON sa.security_id = cl.security_id
JOIN 
    collateral_asset ca ON cl.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
WHERE 
    ca.status = 'RELEASED'
    AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY 
    sa.security_id ASC;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id,
    ca.agreement_id,
    so.security_id,
    so.secured_amount
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    secured_obligation sob ON ca.agreement_id = sob.agreement_id
JOIN 
    security_agreement so ON sob.security_id = so.security_id
JOIN 
    status_catalog sc_loan ON ld.status = sc_loan.status_code
JOIN 
    status_catalog sc_sec ON so.status = sc_sec.status_code
WHERE 
    sc_loan.name_zh = '已核销'
    AND sc_sec.name!_zh = '有效'
ORDER BY 
    so.secured_amount DESC;

WITH LoanBalances AS (
    SELECT 
        i.institution_id,
        i.institution_name,
        l.loan_id,
        lbs.principal_balance,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY i.institution_id 
            ORDER BY lbs.principal_balance DESC, l.loan_id ASC
        ) as rn
    FROM loan_drawdown l
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON l.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON l.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = (
        SELECT MAX(as_of_date) 
        FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs2 
        WHERE lbs2.loan_id = l.loan_id
    )
)
SELECT 
    institution_name,
    loan_id,
    principal_balance,
    rn as balance_rank
FROM LoanBalances
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY institution_name ASC;

WITH LoanBalances AS (
    SELECT 
        l.loan_id,
        ca.contract_amount,
        lb.principal_balance,
        op.industry_code,
        isec.sector_name_zh
    FROM loan_drawdown l
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON l.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lb ON l.loan_id = lb.loan_id
    JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
    JOIN organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
    JOIN industry_sector isec ON op.industry_code = isec.sector_code
    WHERE lb.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM loan_balance_snapshot)
),
RankedLoans AS (
    SELECT 
        sector_name_zh,
        loan_id,
        principal_balance,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY industry_code ORDER BY principal_balance DESC) as rn
    FROM LoanBalances
)
SELECT 
    sector_name_zh AS industry_name_zh,
    loan_id,
    principal_balance,
    rn AS rank_in_industry
FROM RankedLoans
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY sector_name_zh ASC, rn ASC;

SELECT 
    business_date,
    daily_count,
    daily_count - LAG(daily_count, 1, 0) OVER (ORDER BY business_date) AS count_change
FROM (
    SELECT 
        business_date,
        COUNT(*) AS daily_count
    FROM payment_event
    GROUP BY business_date
)
ORDER BY business_date ASC;

WITH LatestLoanBalances AS (
    SELECT 
        ld.loan_id,
        ca.institution_id,
        lbs.principal_balance
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = (
        SELECT MAX(as_of_date) 
        FROM loan_balance_snapshot 
        WHERE loan_id = ld.loan!loan_id
    )
),
InstAvg AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        AVG(principal_balance) AS avg_principal_balance
    FROM LatestLoanBalances
    GROUP BY institution_id
)
SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    llb.loan_id,
    llb.principal_balance,
    ia.avg_principal_balance,
    (llb.principal_balance - ia.avg_principal_balance) AS excess_amount
FROM LatestLoanBalances llb
JOIN InstAvg ia ON llb.institution_id = ia.institution_id
JOIN institution i ON llb.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE llb.principal_balance > ia.avg_principal_balance
ORDER BY excess_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    sa.security_id AS security_contract_id,
    sa.secured_amount AS secured_claim_amount,
    COUNT(gc.commitment_id) AS guarantor_count
FROM 
    main.security_agreement sa
JOIN 
    main.guarantor_commitment gc ON sa.security_id = gc.security_id
LEFT JOIN 
    main.collateral_link cl ON sa.security_id = cl.security_id
WHERE 
    sa.security_type = 'CREDIT'
GROUP BY 
    sa.security_id, sa.secured_amount
HAVING 
    COUNT(cl.collateral_link_id) = 0
ORDER BY 
    sa.secured_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN principal_overdue_days = 0 THEN 0
        WHEN principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 1 AND 30 THEN 1
        WHEN principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 31 AND 90 THEN 31
        WHEN principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 91 AND 180 THEN 91
        WHEN principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 181 AND 360 THEN 181
        ELSE 361
    END AS interval_lower_bound,

WITH transaction_details AS (
    SELECT 
        i.institution_name,
        pe.amount,
        CASE 
            WHEN pe.from_account_id IS NOT NULL THEN ah_from.institution_id
            ELSE ah_to.institution_id
        END AS inst_id,
        p_source.party_id AS source_party_id,
        p_target.party_id AS target_party_id
    FROM payment_event pe
    JOIN account a_from ON pe.from_account_id = a_from.account_id
    JOIN account a_to ON pe.to_account_id = a_to.account_id
    JOIN account_holder ah_from ON a_from.account_id = ah_from.account_id AND ah_from.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
    JOIN account_holder ah_to ON a_to.account_id = ah_to.account_id AND ah_to.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
    JOIN party p_source ON ah_from.party_id = p_source.party_id
    JOIN party p_target ON ah_to.party_id = p_target.party_id
    LEFT JOIN institution i_from ON a_from.institution_id = i_from.institution_id
    LEFT JOIN institution i_to ON a_to.institution_id = i_to.institution_id
    JOIN institution i ON 
        CASE 
            WHEN pe.from_account_id IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(a_from.institution_id, a_to.institution_id)
            ELSE a_to.institution_id
        END = i.institution_id
    WHERE pe.status = 'SUCCESS' -- Assuming only successful transactions count
),
related_transactions AS (
    SELECT 
        td.institution_name,
        td.amount,
        td.inst_id
    FROM transaction_details td
    JOIN party_relation pr ON td.source_party_id = pr.source_party_id AND td.target_party_id = pr.target_party_id
    JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc ON pr.relation_type = rtc.relation_type
    WHERE rtc.relation_name_zh != '非关联方'
      AND pr.effective_from <= (SELECT MAX(event_time) FROM payment_event) -- Simplified time check
      AND (pr.effective_to IS NULL OR pr.effective_to >= (SELECT MIN(event_time) FROM payment_event))
),
total_transactions AS (
    SELECT 
        i.institution_name,
        SUM(td.amount) AS total_amount
    FROM transaction_details td
    JOIN institution i ON td.inst_id = i.institution_id
    GROUP BY i.institution_name
),
related_aggregates AS (
    SELECT 
        i.institution_name,
        SUM(rt.amount) AS related_amount
    FROM related_transactions rt
    JOIN institution i ON rt.inst_id = i.institution_id
    GROUP BY i.institution_name
)
SELECT 
    tt.institution_name,
    COALESCE(ra.related_amount, 0.0) AS related_amount,
    tt.total_amount AS total_amount,
    (COALESCE(ra.related_amount, 0.0) * 1.0 / tt.total_amount) AS ratio
FROM total_transactions tt
LEFT JOIN related_aggregates ra ON tt.institution_name = ra.institution_name
ORDER BY ratio DESC;

),
non_related_exposures AS (

    FROM institution i

        SELECT 1
        FROM party_relation pr
        JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc ON pr.relation_type = rtc.relation_type
        WHERE pr.source_party_id = p.party_id
          AND rtc.relation_name_zh != '非关联方'

    )

)

FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    loan_balance_snapshot ls ON ld.loan_id = ls.loan_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN

JOIN 
    institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN 
    capital_snapshot cs ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id
WHERE 
    ls.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM loan_balance_snapshot WHERE loan_id = ld.loan_id)
    AND cs.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM capital_snapshot WHERE institution_id = i.institution_id)
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name, p.party_id, p.display_name, cs.net_capital

    (SUM(ls.principal_balance) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital) > 0.10

    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
    JOIN party_type_catalog ptc ON ptc.party_type = p.party_type
    WHERE ptc.name_zh = '对公客户'
    AND lbs.as_of_date = (
        SELECT MAX(as_of_date) 
        FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs2 
        JOIN loan_drawdown ld2 ON ld2.loan_id = lbs2.loan_id 
        JOIN credit_agreement ca2 ON ca2.agreement_id = ld2.agreement_id 
        WHERE ca2.institution_id = i.institution_id
    )
    GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name, p.party_id, p.display_name
),
capital_data AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        MAX(as_of_date) AS latest_date,
        MAX(net_capital) AS net_capital
    FROM capital_snapshot
    GROUP BY institution_id
),
ranked_customers AS (
    SELECT 
        le.institution_name,
        le.customer_name,
        le.total_loan_principal,
        cd.net_capital,
        (le.total_loan_principal * 1.0 / NULLIF(cd.net_capital, 0)) AS ratio,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY le.institution_id ORDER BY (le.total_loan_principal * 1.0 / NULLIF(cd.net_capital, 0)) DESC) AS rn
    FROM loan_exposure le
    JOIN capital_data cd ON cd.institution_id = le.institution_id
)
SELECT 
    institution_name,
    customer_name,
    ratio
FROM ranked_customers
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    l.loan_id,
    l.principal_balance,
    NTILE(4) OVER (PARTITION BY i.institution_id ORDER BY l.principal_balance DESC) AS quartile
FROM 
    main.loan_balance_snapshot l
JOIN 
    main.loan_drawdown ld ON l.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN 
    main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    main.institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE 
    l.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM main.loan_balance_snapshot)
ORDER BY 
    quartile ASC,
    l.principal_balance DESC
LIMIT 300;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id,
    i.institution_name,
    lbs.principal_balance,
    ROUND((lbs.principal_balance * 1.0 / inst_total.total_principal) * 1!00, 2) AS ratio_percent
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN 
    loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN 
    (
        SELECT 
            ca_inner.institution_id,
            SUM(lbs_inner.principal_balance) AS total_principal
        FROM 
            loan_drawdown ld_inner
        JOIN 
            credit_agreement ca_inner ON ld_inner.agreement_id = ca_inner.agreement_id
        JOIN 
            loan_balance_snapshot lbs_inner ON ld_inner.loan_id = lbs_inner.loan_id
        GROUP BY 
            ca_inner.institution_id
    ) inst_total ON i.institution_id = inst_total.institution_id
ORDER BY 
    i.institution_name ASC,
    ratio_percent DESC,
    ld.loan_id ASC
LIMIT 300;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.disbursed_amount,
    sc.name_zh AS loan_status,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ds.principal_overdue_days > 0 THEN ds.overdue_principal ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_overdue_principal,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ds.principal_overdue_days > 0 THEN ds.as_of_date END) AS overdue_period_count
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    status_catalog sc ON ld.status = sc.status_code AND sc.entity = 'loan_drawdown'
LEFT JOIN 
    delinquency_snapshot ds ON ld.loan_id = ds.loan_id
WHERE 
    ld.status = '正常'
    AND sc.name_zh = '正常'
GROUP BY 
    ld.loan_id, ld.disbursed_amount, sc.name_zh
HAVING 
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ds.principal_over!> 0 THEN ds.as_of_date END) >= 2
ORDER BY 
    overdue_period_count DESC,
    total_overdue_principal DESC,
    ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT 
    loan_account_id,
    disbursed_on,
    COUNT(*) AS loan_count
FROM 
    loan_drawdown
GROUP BY 
    loan_account_id,
    disbursed_on
HAVING 
    COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY 
    loan_count DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT DISTINCT ah.party_id
FROM account_holder ah
JOIN account a ON ah.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN term_deposit td ON a.account_id = td.account_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ah.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
ORDER BY ah.party_id ASC;

SELECT p.party_id
FROM party p
JOIN staff_member s ON p.party_id = s.person_party_id
JOIN party_type_catalog ptc ON p.party_type = ptc.party_type
WHERE ptc.name_zh = '本行员工'
  AND s.employment_status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND p.party_id NOT IN (
      SELECT ah.party_id
      FROM account_holder ah
      WHERE ah.party_id IS NOT NULL
  )
ORDER BY p.party_id ASC;

SELECT a.account_id
FROM main.account a
WHERE a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
  AND a.account_id NOT IN (
    SELECT pe.from_account_id
    FROM main.payment_event pe
    JOIN main.payment_type_catalog ptc ON pe.payment_type = ptc.payment_type
    WHERE ptc.name_zh = '现金支取'
  )
ORDER BY a.account_id ASC
LIMIT 300;

SELECT security_id, guaranteed_amount
FROM guarantor_commitment
WHERE status = 'EXPIRED'
ORDER BY guaranteed_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(l.current_maturity_on) > 90 THEN '常态'
        WHEN julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(l.current_maturity_on) >= 0 THEN '临期'
        ELSE '已到期'
    END AS bucket,
    COUNT(*) AS count
FROM loan_drawdown l
WHERE l.status != 'CLOSED' -- Assuming we only count open/active loans, adjust if status logic differs
GROUP BY 
    CASE 
        WHEN julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(l.current_maturity_on) > 90 THEN '常态'
        WHEN julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(l.current_maturity_on) >= 0 THEN '临期'

    END
ORDER BY

        WHEN julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(l.current_maturity_on) >= 0 THEN 2
        ELSE 3
    END;

SELECT 
    ca.collateral_id,
    COUNT(cl.security_id) AS association_count
FROM 
    collateral_asset ca
JOIN 
    collateral_link cl ON ca.collateral_id = cl.collateral_id
JOIN 
    security_agreement sa ON cl.security_id = sa.security_id
JOIN 
    status_catalog sc ON sa.status = sc.status_code
WHERE 
    sc.name_zh = '有效'
GROUP BY 
    ca.collateral_id
HAVING 
    COUNT(cl.security_id) > 1
ORDER BY 
    association_count DESC;

SELECT 
    ca.collateral_type,
    AVG(cv.valuation_amount) AS avg_valuation,
    COUNT(cv.valuation_id) AS valuation_count
FROM 
    collateral_asset ca
JOIN 
    collateral_valuation cv ON ca.collateral_id = cv.collateral_id
WHERE 
    cv.appraiser_kind = 'internal'
GROUP BY 
    ca.collateral_type
ORDER BY 
    avg_valuation DESC;

WITH account_loan_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        ld.repayment_account_id,
        COUNT(*) AS loan_count
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    WHERE ld.repayment_account_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ld.repayment_account_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3
),
ranked_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        ld.repayment_account_id,
        ld.loan_id,
        ld.disbursed_on,
        ld.disbursed_amount,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ld.repayment_account_id ORDER BY ld.disbursed_on ASC, ld.loan_id ASC) AS rn
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN account_loan_counts alc ON ld.re!repayment_account_id = alc.repayment_account_id
    WHERE ld.repayment_account_id IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
    rl.repayment_account_id,
    rl.loan_id,
    rl.disbursed_on,
    rl.disbursed_amount,
    alc.loan_count AS account_loan_count
FROM ranked_loans rl
JOIN account_loan_counts alc ON rl.repayment_account_id = alc.repayment_account_id
WHERE rl.rn <= 2
ORDER BY rl.repayment_account_id ASC, rl.disbursed_on ASC;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id,
    ca.contract_amount,
    SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) AS total_disbursed_amount,
    SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) - ca.contract_amount AS excess_amount,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM 
    credit_agreement ca
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
GROUP BY 
    ca.agreement_id, ca.contract_amount
HAVING 
    SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) > ca.contract_amount
ORDER BY 
    ca.agreement_id ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(*) AS account_count,
    SUM(bs.ledger_balance - bs.available_balance) AS total_difference
FROM 
    main.account a
JOIN 
    main.institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN 
    main.account_balance_snapshot bs ON a.account_id = bs.account_id
WHERE 
    bs.ledger_balance > bs.available_balance
    AND (bs.ledger_balance - bs.available_balance) > 5000000
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 
    total_difference DESC;

SELECT 
    td.account_id,
    td.opening_principal,
    td.maturity_on,
    td.annual_interest_rate
FROM 
    term_deposit td
JOIN 
    account acc ON td.account_id = acc.account_id
JOIN 
    status_catalog sc ON acc.status = sc.status_code
WHERE 
    sc.entity = 'account'
    AND sc.name_zh = '正常'
    AND td.maturity_on IS NOT NULL
    AND td.maturity_on <= '2026-06-30'
ORDER BY 
    td.maturity_on ASC;

SELECT 
    pc.card_id,
    ctc.name_zh AS card_type_name,
    pc.issued_on
FROM 
    payment_card pc
JOIN 
    card_type_catalog ctc ON pc.card_type = ctc.card_type
WHERE 
    pc.issued_on <= '2025-01-31'
    AND pc.status = 'ACTIVE'
    AND ctc.name_zh = '借记卡'
ORDER BY 
    pc.issued_on ASC,
    pc.card_id ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN pm.payment_mode_name_zh = '受托支付' THEN ld.disbursed_amount ELSE 0.0 END) AS total_entrusted_amount,
    SUM(CASE WHEN pm.payment_mode_name_zh = '自主支付' THEN ld.disbursed_amount ELSE 0.0 END) AS total_autonomous_amount,
    (SUM(CASE WHEN pm.payment_mode_name_zh = '受托支付' THEN ld.disbursed_amount ELSE 0.0 END) * 1.0 / 
     NULLIF(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount), 0)) AS entrusted_ratio
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN 
    payment_mode_catalog pm ON ld.payment_mode = pm.payment_mode
WHERE 
    pm.payment_mode_name_zh IN ('受托支付', '自主支付')
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING 
    (SUM(CASE WHEN pm.payment_mode_name_zh = '受托支付' THEN ld.disbursed_amount ELSE 0.0 END) * 1.0 / 
     NULLIF(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount), 0)) < 0.52
ORDER BY 
    entrusted_ratio ASC, 
    i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id AS 授信合同编号，
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号，
    ld.disbursed_amount AS 单笔放款金额，
    SUM(ld2.disbursed_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY ld.agreement_id) AS 合同内累计放款金额，
    ROUND(ld.disbursed_amount * 100.0 / SUM(ld2.disbursed_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY ld.agreement_id), 2) AS 单笔占比
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld2 ON ld.agreement_id = ld2.agreement_id
WHERE 
    (ld.disbursed_amount * 1.0 / SUM(ld2.disbursed_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY ld.agreement_id)) > 0.9
GROUP BY 
    ld.loan_id, ld.agreement_id, ld.disbursed_amount, ca.agreement_id
HAVING 
    (ld.disbursed_amount * 1.0 / SUM(ld2.disbursed_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY ld.agreement_id)) > 0.9
ORDER BY 
    ca.agreement_id ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    SUM(wp.actual_raise_amount) AS actual_raise_total,
    SUM(CASE WHEN wp.status = 'ON_SALE' THEN wp.planned_raise_amount ELSE 0 END) AS planned_raise_total,
    SUM(wp.actual_raise_amount) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN wp.status = 'ON_SALE' THEN wp.planned_raise_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS completion_rate
FROM 
    wealth_product wp
JOIN 
    institution i ON wp.issuer_institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING 
    SUM(wp.actual_raise_amount) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN wp.status = 'ON_SALE' THEN wp.planned_raise_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) > 1.2
ORDER BY 
    completion_rate DESC;

WITH overdue_loans AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ld.loan_id, ld.borrower_party_id
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN repayment_schedule rs ON ld.loan_id = rs.loan_id
    WHERE rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
),
all_loans_with_status AS (
    SELECT 
        ld.loan_id,
        ld.borrower_party_id,
        MAX(CASE WHEN rs.status = 'OVERDUE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_overdue_installment
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    LEFT JOIN repayment_schedule rs ON ld.loan_id = rs.loan_id
    GROUP BY ld.loan_id, ld![](@

SELECT 
    pi.instruction_id,
    ld.loan_id,
    bp.display_name AS borrower_name,
    tp.display_name AS actual_payee_name,
    pi.instruction_amount
FROM 
    payment_instruction pi
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON pi.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    party bp ON ca.borrower_party_id = bp.party_id
JOIN 
    party tp ON pi.intended_payee_party_id = tp.party_id
WHERE 
    pi.status = 'EXECUTED'
    AND pi.intended_payee_party_id IS NOT NULL
    AND pi.intended_payee_party_id != ca.borrower_party_id
ORDER BY 
    pi.instruction_amount DESC,
    pi.instruction_id ASC;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.disbursed_on,
    ca.agreement_id,
    ca.signed_on,
    ld.disbursed_amount
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
WHERE 
    ld.disbursed_on < ca.signed_on
ORDER BY 
    ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id,
    COUNT(rs.installment_id) AS unpaid_installment_count,
    ROUND(SUM(rs.principal_due), 2) AS total_principal_due
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    repayment_schedule rs ON ld.loan_id = rs.loan_id
JOIN 
    status_catalog sc ON rs.status = sc.status_code AND sc.entity = 'repayment_schedule'
WHERE 
    sc.name_zh != '已结清'
    AND ld.loan_id NOT IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT rs_inner.loan_id
        FROM repayment_schedule rs_inner
        JOIN status_catalog sc_inner ON rs_inner.status = sc_inner.status_code AND sc![_entity='repayment_schedule']
        WHERE sc_inner.name_zh = '!已结清'
    )
GROUP BY 
    ld.loan_id
ORDER BY 
    total_principal_due DESC, 
    ld.loan_id ASC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT 
    l.loan_id,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance, 2) AS principal_balance,
    ROUND(lbs.overdue_principal, 2) AS overdue_principal
FROM 
    loan_drawdown l
JOIN 
    loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON l.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN 
    risk_classification rc ON l.loan_id = rc.loan_id
JOIN 
    classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
JOIN 
    status_catalog sc ON l.status = sc.status_code
WHERE 
    sc.name_zh = '已核销'
    AND lbs.principal_balance > 10000000.0
ORDER BY 
    lbs.principal_balance DESC,
    l.loan_id ASC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.disbursed_on,
    ld.disbursement_account_id,
    a.opened_on
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    account a ON ld.disbursement_account_id = a.account_id
WHERE 
    ld.disbursed_on < a.opened_on
ORDER BY 
    ld.disbursed_on ASC,
    ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.disbursement_account_id,
    a.account_kind,
    ld.disbursed_amount
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    account a ON ld.disbursement_account_id = a.account_id
WHERE 
    a.account_kind = '储蓄类账户'
ORDER BY 
    ld.disbursed_amount DESC,
    ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id,
    ca.security_type,
    ca.contract_amount,
    p.display_name
FROM 
    credit_agreement ca
JOIN 
    party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE 
    ca.security_type = 'CREDIT'
    AND ca.contract_amount > 8000000
ORDER BY 
    ca.contract_amount DESC,
    ca.agreement_id ASC;

WITH non_related_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.agreement_id,
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        ca.institution_id,
        ca.product_family,
        ca.annual_interest_rate,
        p.display_name AS borrower_name
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party! = p.party_id
    WHERE ca.annual_interest_rate IS NOT NULL
      AND ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 
          FROM party_relation pr
          JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc ON pr.relation_type = rtc.relation_type
          WHERE pr.source_party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
            AND rtc.relation_name_zh = '非关联方'
      )
),
institution_product_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        product_family,
        AVG(annual_interest_rate) AS avg_rate
    FROM non_related_loans
    GROUP BY institution_id, product_family
)
SELECT 
    nl.borrower_name,
    nl.borrower_party_id AS customer_id,
    nl.annual_interest_rate AS contract_rate,
    ipa.avg_rate AS avg_institution_rate,
    (nl.annual_interest_rate - ipa.avg_rate) AS rate_spread
FROM non_related_loans nl
JOIN institution_product_avg ipa 
    ON nl.institution_id = ipa.institution_id 
    AND nl.product_family = ipa.product_family
WHERE nl.annual_interest_rate < ipa.avg_rate
ORDER BY rate_spread DESC;

SELECT 
    pr.source_party_id,
    pr.target_party_id,
    rtc.relation_name_zh
FROM 
    party_relation pr
JOIN 
    relation_type_catalog rtc ON pr.relation_type = rtc.relation_type
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca1 ON pr.source_party_id = ca1.borrower_party_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca2 ON pr.target_party_id = ca2.borrower_party_id
WHERE 
    rtc.relation_name_zh != '非关联方'
ORDER BY 
    rtc.relation_name_zh ASC,
    pr.relation_id ASC;

SELECT 
    eg.group_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS member_count,
    SUM(ls.principal_balance) AS total_principal_balance,
    cs.net_capital,
    (SUM(ls.principal_balance) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital) AS ratio
FROM exposure_group eg
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
JOIN risk_exposure re ON eg.exposure_group_id = re.exposure_group_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON re.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot ls ON ld.loan_id = ls.loan_id
JOIN institution inst ON eg.institution_id = inst.institution_id
JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON inst.institution_id = cs.institution_id
WHERE 
    ls.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM loan_balance_snapshot WHERE loan_id = ls.loan_id)
    AND cs.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM capital_snapshot WHERE institution_id = cs.institution_id)
    AND re.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM risk_exposure WHERE exposure_group_id = re.exposure_group_id)
GROUP BY eg.group_name, cs.net_capital
HAVING 
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) >= 2
    AND (SUM(ls.principal_balance) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital) > 0.1
ORDER BY ratio DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT 
    p_from.display_name AS payer_name,
    p_to.display_name AS payee_name,
    COUNT(*) AS transfer_count,
    SUM(pe.amount) AS total_amount
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN account acc_from ON pe.from_account_id = acc_from.account_id
JOIN account acc_to ON pe.to_account_id = acc_to.account_id
JOIN account_holder ah_from ON acc_from.account_id = ah_from.account_id 
    AND ah_from.effective_to IS NULL
JOIN account_holder ah_to ON acc_to.account_id = ah_to.account_id 
    AND ah_to.e!_to IS NULL
JOIN party p_from ON ah_from.party_id = p_from.party_id
JOIN party p_to ON ah_to.party_id = p_to.party_id
JOIN party_relation pr ON p_from.party_id = pr.source_party_id AND p_to.party_id = pr.target_party_id
    AND pr.effective_to IS NULL
JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc ON pr.relation_type = rtc.relation_type
JOIN payment_type_catalog ptc ON pe.payment_type = ptc.payment_type
WHERE ptc.name_zh = '转账'
  AND rtc.relation_name_zh != '非关联方'
GROUP BY p_from.party_id, p_to.party_id, p_from.display_name, p_to.display_name
ORDER BY total_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    wp.product_id,
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_name
FROM 
    wealth_product wp
JOIN 
    product_holding_snapshot phs ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
JOIN 
    managed_asset ma ON phs.asset_id = ma.asset_id
JOIN 
    status_catalog sc ON wp.status = sc.status_code AND sc.entity = 'wealth_product'
WHERE 
    sc.name_zh = '在售'
    AND wp.risk_level = 'R5'
    AND phs.lookthrough_depth > 1
ORDER BY 
    wp.product_id ASC;

SELECT 
    product_id,
    COUNT(*) AS asset_count
FROM 
    product_holding_snapshot
WHERE 
    lookthrough_depth > 1
GROUP BY 
    product_id
ORDER BY 
    asset_count DESC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT 
    l.loan_id,
    lbs.principal_balance,
    MAX(ds.principal_overdue_days) AS max_overdue_days
FROM 
    loan_drawdown l
JOIN 
    loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON l.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN 
    delinquency_snapshot ds ON l.loan_id = ds.loan_id
WHERE 
    lbs.principal_balance > 90000000.0
    AND ds.overdue_principal > 0.0
GROUP BY 
    l.loan_id, lbs.principal_balance
HAVING 
    MAX(ds.principal_overdue_days) >= 200
ORDER BY 
    max_overdue_days DESC,
    l.loan_id ASC;

SELECT 
    eg.exposure_group_id,
    eg.group_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT re.institution_id) AS institution_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT re.obligor_party_id) AS member_count
FROM 
    exposure_group eg
JOIN 
    risk_exposure re ON eg.exposure_group_id = re.exposure_group_id
WHERE 
    re.agreement_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 
    eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(DISTINCT re.institution_id) >= 2
ORDER BY 
    institution_count DESC;

SELECT 
    eg.exposure_group_id AS group_id,
    eg.group_name AS group_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS overdue_member_count,
    SUM(lbs.overdue_principal) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM exposure_group eg
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id IN (
    SELECT ca.agreement_id 
    FROM credit_agreement ca 
    WHERE ca.borrower_party_id = egm.party_id
)
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE lbs.overdue_principal > 0
GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name
ORDER BY total_overdue_principal DESC;

WITH borrower_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        SUM(ca.contract_amount) AS total_loan_amount
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    WHERE ca.borrower_party_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ca.borrower_party_id
),
guarantor_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        gc.guarantor_party_id,
        SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) AS total_guarantee_amount
    FROM guarantor_commitment gc
    WHERE gc.guarantor_party_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY gc.guarantor_party_id
),
combined AS (
    SELECT 
        p.party_id,
        p.display_name AS enterprise_name,
        COALESCE(g.total_guarantee_amount, 0) AS total_guarantee_amount,
        COALESCE(b.total_loan_amount, 0) AS total_loan_amount,
        (COALESCE(g.total_guarantee_amount, 0) - COALESCE(b.total_loan_amount, 0)) AS guarantee_loan_diff
    FROM party p
    JOIN borrower_totals b ON p.party_id = b.borrower_party_id
    JOIN guarantor_totals g ON p.party_id = g.guarantor_party_id
    WHERE p.party_type = 'CORPORATE'
      AND COALESCE(g.total_guarantee_amount, 0) > COALESCE(b.total_loan_amount, 0)
)
SELECT 
    enterprise_name,
    party_id AS customer_id,
    total_guarantee_amount AS total_external_guarantee,
    total_loan_amount AS total_own_loan,
    guarantee_loan_diff AS guarantee_loan_difference
FROM combined
ORDER BY guarantee_loan_diff DESC;

SELECT 
    p.display_name AS employee_name,
    s.staff_id AS employee_id,
    COUNT(ca.agreement_id) AS contract_count
FROM 
    staff_member s
JOIN 
    party p ON s.person_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON s.person_party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
WHERE 
    s.employment_status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY 
    s.staff_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY 
    contract_count DESC;

SELECT 
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    p.party_id AS customer_id,
    SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_principal_balance,
    pp.annual_income,
    ROUND((SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income), 2) AS multiple
FROM 
    party p
JOIN 
    person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN 
    loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
WHERE 
    p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
    AND pp.annual_income IS NOT NULL
    AND pp.annual_income > 0
GROUP BY 
    p.party_id, p.display_name, pp.annual_income
HAVING 
    (SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income) > 2
ORDER BY 
    multiple DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT 
    p.display_name AS staff_name,
    so.operator_id AS operator_id,
    so.authority_level AS!authority_level,
    COUNT(ca.agreement_id) AS self_loan_contract_count
FROM 
    staff_member sm
JOIN 
    party p ON sm.person_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    party_type_catalog ptc ON p.party_type = ptc.party_type
JOIN 
    staff_assignment sa ON sm.staff_id = sa.staff_id
JOIN 
    service_operator so ON sm.staff_id = so.staff_id
LEFT JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
WHERE 
    ptc.name_zh = '本行员工'
    AND sa.role_title = '客户经理'
    AND so.operator_kind = '信贷经办员'
GROUP BY 
    p.display_name, so.operator_id, so.authority_level
ORDER BY 
    self_loan_contract_count DESC;

SELECT 
    p.display_name AS employee_name,
    ld.loan_id AS loan_receipt_id,
    ld.disbursed_amount AS disbursement_amount,
    ld.disbursed_on AS disbursement_date
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    account a ON ld.disbursement_account_id = a.account_id
JOIN 
    account_holder ah ON a.account_id = ah.account_id
JOIN 
    party p ON ah.party_id = p.party_id
WHERE 
    p.party_type = 'STAFF'
    AND ah.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
ORDER BY 
    ld.disbursed_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    p.party_id AS customer_id,
    pp.annual_income AS annual_income,
    SUM(rs.principal_due + rs.interest_due) AS total_repayment,
    ROUND(SUM(rs.principal_due + rs.interest_due) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income, 2) AS repayment_to_income_ratio
FROM 
    repayment_schedule rs
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON rs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
WHERE 
    p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
    AND pp.annual_income IS NOT NULL
    AND pp.annual_income > 0
GROUP BY 
    p.party_id, p.display_name, pp.annual_income
ORDER BY 
    repayment_to_income_ratio DESC,
    p.party_id ASC
LIMIT 50;

SELECT 
    lpc.product_name_zh AS product_category_name,
    COUNT(rs.installment_id) AS overdue_installment_count,
    SUM(COALESCE(lbs.overdue_principal, 0)) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    loan_product_catalog lpc ON ca.product_family = lpc.product_code
JOIN 
    repayment_schedule rs ON ld.loan_id = rs.loan_id
LEFT JOIN 
    loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id AND lbs.as_of_date = (
        SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM loan_balance_snapshot WHERE loan_id = ld.loan_id
    )
WHERE 
    rs.status != 'PAID' 
    AND rs.due_date < DATE('now')
GROUP BY 
    lpc.product_name_zh
ORDER BY 
    total_overdue_principal DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN td.maturity_on < '2026-06-30' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS expired_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN td.maturity_on >= '2026-06-30' AND td.maturity_on <= date('2026-06-30', '+90 days') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS within_90_days_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN td.maturity_on > date('2026-06-30', '+90 days') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS over_90_days_count
FROM 
    term_deposit td
JOIN 
    account a ON td.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN 
    institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING 
    SUM(CASE WHEN td.maturity_on < '2026-06-30' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 20
ORDER BY 
    expired_count DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

WITH joint_accounts AS (
    SELECT 
        acc.org_unit_id,
        acc.account_id
    FROM 
        account acc
    JOIN 
        account_holder ah ON acc.account_id = ah.account_id
    GROUP BY 
        acc.account_id, acc.org_unit_id
    HAVING 
        COUNT(DISTINCT ah.party_id) > 1
)
SELECT 
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(ja.account_id) AS joint_account_count
FROM 
    organization_unit ou
JOIN 
    joint_accounts ja ON ou.org_unit_id = ja.org_unit_id
GROUP BY 
    ou.org_unit_id, 
    ou.unit_name
ORDER BY 
    joint_account_count DESC;

SELECT 
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS overdue_count,
    SUM(lbs.overdue_principal) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    organization_unit ou ON ca.managing_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
JOIN 
    loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
WHERE 
    lbs.as_of_date = (
        SELECT MAX(as_of_date) 
        FROM loan_balance_snapshot 
        WHERE loan_id = ld.loan_id
    )
    AND lbs.overdue_principal > 0
GROUP BY 
    ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY 
    total_overdue_principal DESC;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN rs.status != 'PAID' AND rs.due_date < DATE('now') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS overdue_installment_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN rs.status != 'PAID' AND rs.due_date < DATE('now') THEN rs.principal_due ELSE 0.0 END) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    repayment_schedule rs ON ld.loan_id = rs.loan_id
WHERE 
    ld.loan_id IN (
        SELECT loan_id
        FROM repayment_schedule
        WHERE status != 'PAID' AND due_date < DATE('now')
        GROUP BY loan_id
        HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN status != 'PAID' AND due_date < DATE('now') THEN principal_due ELSE 0.0 END) > 120000000.0
    )
GROUP BY 
    ld.loan_id
HAVING 
    SUM(CASE WHEN rs.status != 'PAID' AND rs.due_date < DATE('now') THEN rs.principal_due ELSE 0.0 END) > 0
ORDER BY 
    total_overdue_principal DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN rs.status != 'PAID' OR rs.paid_on IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS overdue_installments,
    SUM(rs.interest_due) AS total_interest_due
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN 
    repayment_schedule rs ON ld.loan_id = rs.loan_id
WHERE 
    rs.status != 'PAID' OR rs.paid_on IS NULL
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING 
    SUM(CASE WHEN rs.status != 'PAID' OR rs.paid_on IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 30
ORDER BY 
    overdue_installments DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS overdue_loan_count
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN 
    repayment_schedule rs ON ld.loan_id = rs.loan_id
WHERE 
    rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) >= 240
ORDER BY 
    overdue_loan_count DESC;

SELECT 
    loan_id,
    installment_no,
    principal_due,
    interest_due
FROM 
    repayment_schedule
WHERE 
    status != 'PAID' 
    AND paid_on IS NULL
    AND principal_due > 90000000
ORDER BY 
    principal_due DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    SUM(cf.limit_amount) AS total_credit_limit,
    SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) AS total_disbursed_amount,
    cs.net_capital,
    ROUND(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital, 4) AS disbursement_to_capital_ratio
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    credit_facility cf ON i.institution_id = cf.institution_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON cf.facility_id = ca.facility_id
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN 
    capital_snapshot cs ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name, cs.net_capital
HAVING 
    SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) > cs.net_capital
ORDER BY 
    disbursement_to_capital_ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    sa.security_id AS security_agreement_id,
    sa.secured_amount AS secured_amount_setting,
    COUNT(gc.commitment_id) AS guarantor_count,
    SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) AS total_guaranteed_amount
FROM 
    security_agreement sa
JOIN 
    guarantor_commitment gc ON sa.security_id = gc.security_id
JOIN 
    status_catalog sc ON gc.status = sc.status_code AND sc.entity = 'guarantor_commitment'
WHERE 
    sc.name_zh = '有效'
    AND sa.security_type = '保证担保'
GROUP BY 
    sa.security_id, sa.secured_amount
HAVING 
    SUM(gc.g!guaranteed_amount) < sa.secured_amount
ORDER BY 
    total_guaranteed_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    cf.facility_id,
    cf.limit_amount,
    sc.name_zh AS status_name
FROM 
    credit_facility cf
JOIN 
    status_catalog sc ON cf.status = sc.status_code AND sc.entity = 'credit_facility'
WHERE 
    cf.facility_type = '循环授信额度'
ORDER BY 
    cf.limit_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    cf.facility_type,
    SUM(cf.limit_amount) AS total_limit_amount
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    credit_facility cf ON i.institution_id = cf.institution_id
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id,
    i.institution_name,
    cf.facility_type
HAVING 
    SUM(cf.limit_amount) > 2000000000
ORDER BY 
    total_limit_amount DESC;

SELECT facility_type, COUNT(*) AS record_count
FROM credit_facility
WHERE limit_amount > 300000000
GROUP BY facility_type
ORDER BY record_count DESC;

SELECT pmc.payment_mode_name_zh, COUNT(*) AS record_count
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN payment_mode_catalog pmc ON ld.payment_mode = pmc.payment_mode
GROUP BY pmc.payment_mode_name_zh
ORDER BY record_count DESC;

WITH RankedProducts AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id,
        minimum_holding_days,
        NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY actual_raise_amount DESC) AS group_id
    FROM wealth_product
    WHERE status = 'ON_SALE'
),
GroupStats AS (
    SELECT 
        group_id,
        COUNT(*) AS product_count
    FROM RankedProducts
    WHERE minimum_holding_days > 0
    GROUP BY group_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) BETWEEN 31 AND 33
)
SELECT 
    group_id,
    product_count
FROM GroupStats
ORDER BY group_id ASC;

SELECT 
    SUM(cf.limit_amount) AS total_revolving_limit,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM 
    credit_facility cf
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON cf.facility_id = ca.facility_id
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN 
    payment_instruction pi ON ld.loan_id = pi.loan_id
JOIN 
    payment_mode_catalog pmc ON pi.payment_mode = pmc.payment_mode
WHERE 
    cf.facility_type = 'TERM'
    AND pmc.payment_mode_name_zh = '受托支付'
ORDER BY 
    total_revolving_limit DESC;

SELECT 
    pmc.payment_mode_name_zh,
    COUNT(*) AS pending_count
FROM 
    payment_instruction pi
JOIN 
    payment_mode_catalog pmc ON pi.payment_mode = pmc.payment_mode
WHERE 
    pi.status = 'PENDING'
GROUP BY 
    pmc.payment_mode_name_zh
ORDER BY 
    pending_count DESC;

SELECT 
    itc.name_zh AS instrument_type_name_zh,
    sc.name_zh AS status_name_zh
FROM 
    instrument_type_catalog itc
CROSS JOIN 
    status_catalog sc
WHERE 
    sc.entity = 'loan_drawdown'
ORDER BY 
    itc.name_zh,
    sc.name_zh;

SELECT 
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(sa.staff_id) AS credit_manager_count
FROM 
    organization_unit ou
JOIN 
    staff_assignment sa ON ou.org_unit_id = sa.org_unit_id
WHERE 
    sa.role_title = '客户经理'
GROUP BY 
    ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY 
    credit_manager_count DESC;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id,
    cg.grade_name_zh,
    ds.principal_overdue_days,
    ds.overdue_principal
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    delinquency_snapshot ds ON ld.loan_id = ds.loan_id
JOIN 
    risk_classification rc ON ld.loan![](loan_id) = rc.loan_id AND ds.as_of_date = rc.as_of_date
JOIN 
    classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
WHERE 
    ds.principal_overdue_days > 30
    AND cg.grade_name_zh = '正常'
ORDER BY 
    ds.principal_overdue_days DESC,
    ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS insufficient_coverage_count
FROM 
    loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN 
    provision_snapshot ps ON ld.loan_id = ps.loan_id
JOIN 
    risk_classification rc ON ld.loan_id = rc.loan_id
WHERE 
    rc.as_of_date = ps.as_of_date
    AND rc.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    AND ps.provision_stage = 'STAGE_2'
    AND (ps.recognized_amount * 1.0 / NULLIF(ps.required_amount, 0)) < 0.5
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 
    insufficient_coverage_count DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN p.recognized_amount < p.required_amount THEN (p.required_amount - p.recognized_amount)
            ELSE 0.0
        END
    ) AS provision_gap_total
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    provision_snapshot p ON p.loan_id = ld.loan_id
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING 
    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN p.recognized_amount < p.required_amount THEN (p.required_amount - p.recognized_amount)
            ELSE 0.0
        END
    ) > 0
ORDER BY 
    provision_gap_total DESC,
    i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    a.account_id,
    a.account_subtype,
    abs.ledger_balance AS book_balance
FROM 
    main.account a
JOIN 
    main.status_catalog sc ON a.status = sc.status_code AND sc.entity = 'account'
JOIN 
    main.account_balance_snapshot abs ON a.account_id = abs.account_id
LEFT JOIN 
    main.account_holder ah_secondary ON a.account_id = ah_secondary.account_id 
        AND ah_secondary.holder_role != 'PRIMARY'
        AND ah_secondary.effective_to IS NULL
WHERE 
    sc.name_zh = '久悬'
    AND a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
    AND ah_secondary.account_holder_id IS NULL
ORDER BY 
    abs.ledger_balance DESC;

SELECT 
    p.customer_segment AS customer_segment,
    COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM 
    party p
JOIN 
    person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
WHERE 
    p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
    AND pp.annual_income > 1000000.0
GROUP BY 
    p.customer_segment
ORDER BY 
    customer_count DESC,
    customer_segment ASC;

SELECT ma.asset_category_primary, COUNT(*) AS asset_count
FROM managed_asset ma
JOIN private_credit_profile pcp ON ma.asset_id = pcp.asset_id
JOIN industry_sector ind ON pcp.project_industry_code = ind.sector_code
WHERE ind.risk_category = 'Restricted'
GROUP BY ma.asset_category_primary
HAVING COUNT(*) < 33
ORDER BY asset_count DESC, ma.asset_category_primary ASC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id,
    pp.annual_income,
    SUM(cf.limit_amount) AS total_credit_limit,
    ROUND(SUM(cf.limit_amount) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income, 2) AS debt_service_ratio
FROM 
    party p
JOIN 
    person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
JOIN 
    credit_facility cf ON p.party_id = cf.obligor_party_id
JOIN 
    party_type_catalog ptc ON p.party_type = ptc.party_type
WHERE 
    ptc.name_zh = '个人客户'
    AND pp.annual_income IS NOT NULL
    AND pp.annual_income > 0
GROUP BY 
    p.party_id, pp.annual_income
HAVING 
    (SUM(cf.limit_amount) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income) > 3
ORDER BY 
    debt_service_ratio DESC,
    p.party_id ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
    pp.occupation_code,
    pp.employment_sector,
    COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM 
    party p
JOIN 
    person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
JOIN 
    party_type_catalog ptc ON p.party_type = ptc.party_type
WHERE 
    ptc.name_zh = '个人客户'
GROUP BY 
    pp.occupation_code,
    pp.employment_sector
ORDER BY 
    customer_count DESC,
    pp.occupation_code ASC,
    pp.employment_sector ASC;

SELECT 
    pc.status AS card_status,
    COUNT(*) AS issue_count
FROM 
    payment_card pc
JOIN 
    card_type_catalog ctc ON pc.card_type = ctc.card_type
WHERE 
    ctc.name_zh = '借记卡'
GROUP BY 
    pc.status
ORDER BY 
    issue_count DESC,
    pc.status ASC;

SELECT 
    ou.org_unit_id AS 营业单元编号，
    ou.unit_name AS 营业单元名称，
    COUNT(*) AS 交易笔数，
    ROUND(SUM(pe.amount), 2) AS 金额合计
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN account from_acc ON pe.from_account_id = from_acc.account_id
JOIN payment_card pc ON from_acc.account_id = pc.settlement_account_id
JOIN party holder ON pc.holder_party_id = holder.party_id
JOIN organization_unit ou ON holder.home_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
JOIN card_type_catalog ctc ON pc.card_type = ctc.card_type
WHERE ctc.name_zh = '贷记卡'
  AND pe.is_cash = 1
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY 金额合计 DESC, 营业单元名称 ASC;

SELECT 
    pe.payment_id,
    pc.card_id,
    pc.holder_party_id,
    pe.business_date,
    pe.amount
FROM 
    payment_event pe
JOIN 
    account a ON pe.from_account_id = a.account_id
JOIN 
    payment_card pc ON a.account_id = pc.settlement_account_id
JOIN 
    card_type_catalog ctc ON pc.card_type = ctc.card_type
WHERE 
    ctc.name_zh = '贷记卡'
    AND pe.is_cash = 1
ORDER BY 
    pe.amount DESC,
    pe.payment_id ASC,
    pc.card_id ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
    pc.holder_party_id,
    COUNT(*) AS cash_transaction_count,
    ROUND(SUM(pe.amount), 2) AS total_amount
FROM 
    payment_card pc
JOIN 
    payment_event pe ON pc.settlement_account_id = pe.from_account_id OR pc.settlement_account_id = pe.to_account_id
JOIN 
    card_type_catalog ctc ON pc.card_type = ctc.card_type
WHERE 
    ctc.name_zh = '贷记卡'
    AND pe.is_cash = 1
GROUP BY 
    pc.holder_party_id
HAVING 
    COUNT(*) > 5
ORDER BY 
    cash_transaction_count DESC,
    total_amount DESC;

SELECT holder_party_id, COUNT(*) AS card_count
FROM payment_card
GROUP BY holder_party_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 3
ORDER BY card_count DESC, holder_party_id ASC;

SELECT 
    ctc.name_zh AS card_type_name,
    COUNT(pe.payment_id) AS transaction_count,

WITH borrower_guarantor AS (
    SELECT 
        p.party_id,
        p.display_name,
        SUM(COALESCE(ca.contract_amount, 0)) AS total_borrowed_amount,
        SUM(COALESCE(gc.guaranteed_amount, 0)) AS total_guaranteed_amount
    FROM party p
    -- Join with credit agreements where the party is the borrower
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
    -- Join with guarantor commitments where the party is the guarantor
    JOIN guarantor_commitment gc ON p.party_id = gc.guarantor_party_id
    -- Ensure the guarantor commitment is effective (status check usually implies active, but we filter by logic if needed)
    -- The problem asks for "effective" guarantees, assuming status='有效' in a real scenario, 
    -- but based on schema, we sum amounts directly. If status column exists in guarantor_commitment, we would filter.
    -- Looking at schema: guarantor_commitment has no status column, but has effective_from/to.
    -- We assume current date falls within effective range for "effective" commitments.
    WHERE 
        (gc.effective_from IS NULL OR gc.effective_from <= date('now'))
        AND (gc.effective_to IS NULL OR gc.effective_to >= date('now'))
        AND (ca.effective_from IS NULL OR ca.effective_from <= date('now'))
        AND (ca.effective_to IS NULL OR ca.effective_to >= date('now'))
    GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
    HAVING SUM(COALESCE(gc.guaranteed_amount, 0)) > SUM(COALESCE(ca.contract_amount, 0))
)
SELECT 
    party_id AS "保证人编号",
    display_name AS "保证人名称",

ORDER BY total_guaranteed_amount DESC;

WITH RECURSIVE asset_lineage AS (
    SELECT 
        wp.product_id,
        wp.product_name,
        pa.asset_id,
        pa.obligor_party_id,
        pa.asset_name,
        1 as depth
    FROM wealth_product wp
    JOIN product_holding_snapshot phs ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
    JOIN managed_asset pa ON phs.asset_id = pa.asset_id
    WHERE wp.status = 'ACTIVE'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        al.product_id,
        al.product_name,
        ma.asset_id,
        ma.obligor_party_id,
        ma.asset_name,
        al.depth + 1
    FROM asset_lineage al
    JOIN product_holding_snapshot phs ON al.asset_id = phs.product_id
    JOIN managed_asset ma ON phs.asset_id = ma.asset_id
    WHERE al.depth < 10
),
final_holdings AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id,
        product_name,
        asset_id,
        asset_name,
        obligor_party_id
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            product_id,
            product_name,
            asset_id,
            asset![](asset_name)
            obligor_party_id,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id, asset_id ORDER BY depth DESC) as rn
        FROM asset_lineage
        WHERE obligor_party_id IS NOT NULL
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),
overdue_borrowers AS (
    SELECT 
        ld.loan_id,
        p.party_id,
        SUM(COALESCE(lbs.overdue_principal, 0)) as total_overdue_principal
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN party p ON ld.agreement_id IN (
        SELECT ca.agreement_id FROM credit_agreement ca WHERE ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
    )
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM loan_balance_snapshot WHERE loan_id = ld.loan_id)
    AND lbs.overdue_principal > 0
    GROUP BY ld.loan_id, p.party_id
),
borrower_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        party_id,
        SUM(total_overdue_principal) as total_overdue_sum
    FROM overdue_borrowers
    GROUP BY party_id
    HAVING SUM(total_overdue_principal) > 0
)
SELECT 
    fh.product_name,
    fh.asset_name,
    fh.obligor_party_id,
    bt.total_overdue_sum
FROM final_holdings fh
JOIN borrower_totals bt ON fh.obligor_party_id = bt.party_id
JOIN wealth_product wp ON fh.product_id = wp.product_id
JOIN institution inst ON wp.issuer_institution_id = inst.institution_id
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM credit_agreement ca
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    WHERE ca.borrower_party_id = fh.obligor_party_id

    AND ld.status != 'CLOSED'
)
ORDER BY fh.product_name ASC, bt.total_overdue_sum DESC;
