JOIN credit_agreement ca ON egm.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id AND ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE eg.group_type = 'CONNECTED_CUSTOMER'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) >= 5
ORDER BY total_contract_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    wp.product_id,
    wp.product_name,
    SUM(phs.carrying_amount - phs.fair_value) AS total_inversion_amount,
    COUNT(*) AS inversion_position_count
FROM 
    wealth_product wp
JOIN 
    product_holding_snapshot phs ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
WHERE 
    phs.carrying_amount > phs.fair_value
GROUP BY 
    wp.product_id, wp.product_name
HAVING 
    SUM(phs.carrying_amount![](![)phs.fair_value) > 0
ORDER BY 
    total_inversion_amount DESC,
    wp.product_id ASC;

WITH RECURSIVE AssetLineage AS (
    SELECT 
        phs.product_id,
        phs.asset_id,
        phs.lookthrough_depth,
        phs.carrying_amount,
        ma.issuer_party_id,
        ma.asset_name,
        ma.asset_id AS root_asset_id,
        phs.holding_id
    FROM product_holding_snapshot phs
    JOIN managed_asset ma ON phs.asset_id = ma.asset_id
    WHERE phs.lookthrough_depth >= 3
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        al.product_id,
        ma_next.asset_id,
        al.lookthrough_depth,
        al.carrying_amount,
        ma_next.issuer_party_id,
        ma_next.asset_name,
        al.root_asset_id,
        al.holding_id
    FROM AssetLineage al
    JOIN managed_asset ma_prev ON al.asset_id = ma_prev.asset_id
    JOIN product_asset_trade pat ON ma_prev.asset_id = pat.asset_id AND pat.product_id = al.product_id
    JOIN managed_asset ma_next ON pat.counterparty_product_id IS NULL AND ma_next.asset_id = pat.asset_id
    WHERE ma_prev.asset_scope = 'SPV' OR ma_prev.asset_scope = 'Fund'
),
OverdueIssuers AS (
    SELECT 
        ld.loan_account_id,
        p.party_id,
        SUM(COALESCE(lbs.overdue_principal, 0)) AS total_overdue_principal
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    WHERE ca.institution_id = (
        SELECT institution_id FROM institution WHERE institution_id = (
            SELECT issuer_institution_id FROM wealth_product WHERE product_id = (SELECT product_id FROM AssetLineage LIMIT 1)
        )
    )
    AND lbs.overdue_principal > 0
    GROUP BY ld.loan_account_id, p.party_id
)
SELECT 
    wp.product_name,
    al.asset_name AS underlying_asset_name,
    al.lookthrough_depth,
    al.carrying_amount AS book_value,
    COALESCE(oi.total_overdue_principal, 0) AS issuer_total_overdue_principal
FROM AssetLineage al
JOIN wealth_product wp ON al.product_id = wp.product_id
JOIN managed_asset ma_root ON al.root_asset_id = ma_root.asset_id
LEFT JOIN OverdueIssuers oi ON ma_root.issuer_party_id = oi.party_id
WHERE oi.party_id IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY al.lookthrough_depth DESC, al.holding_id ASC;

SELECT 
    cl.collateral_id,
    COUNT(*) AS first_rank_valid_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN cl.pledge_ratio > 0.6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_ratio_count
FROM 
    collateral_link cl
JOIN 
    status_catalog sc ON cl.status = sc.status_code AND sc.entity = 'collateral_link'
WHERE 
    sc.name_zh = '有效'
    AND cl.lien_priority = 1
GROUP BY 
    cl.collateral_id
HAVING 
    SUM(CASE WHEN cl.pledge_ratio > 0.6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 2
ORDER BY 
    high_ratio_count DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    fs.total_assets,
    fs.total_liabilities,
    fs.net_assets,
    fs.annual_revenue
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
ORDER BY 
    fs.annual_revenue DESC;

SELECT 
    p.display_name AS institution_name,
    ROUND((fs.total_liabilities * 1.0 / fs.total_assets), 4) AS debt_to_asset_ratio
FROM 
    financial_snapshot fs
JOIN 
    party p ON fs.party_id = p.party_id
WHERE 
    p.party_id LIKE 'PTY-%'
    AND fs.total_assets > 0
ORDER BY 
    debt_to_asset_ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(cs.tier1_capital * 1.0 / cs.risk_weighted_assets, 4) AS tier1_rwa_ratio
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    capital_snapshot cs ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id
WHERE 
    cs.risk_weighted_assets > 0
ORDER BY 
    tier1_rwa_ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(cs.net_capital * 1.0 / fs.total_assets, 6) AS capital_to_asset_ratio
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    capital_snapshot cs ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id
JOIN 
    financial_snapshot fs ON 'PTY-' || i.institution_id = fs.party_id
WHERE 
    cs.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM capital_snapshot WHERE institution_id = i.institution_id)
    AND fs.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM financial_snapshot WHERE party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id)
ORDER BY 
    capital_to_asset_ratio DESC;

WITH institution_revenue AS (
    SELECT 
        i.institution_id,
        i.institution_name,
        fs.annual_revenue AS revenue
    FROM institution i
    JOIN financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = ('PTY-' || i.institution_id)
    WHERE fs.annual_revenue IS NOT NULL
),
total_revenue AS (
    SELECT SUM(revenue) AS total_rev FROM institution_revenue
),
revenue_with_ratio AS (
    SELECT 
        ir.institution_name,
        ir.revenue,
        ROUND((ir.revenue * 1.0 / tr.total_rev) * 100, 2) AS ratio
    FROM institution_revenue ir
    CROSS JOIN total_revenue tr
)
SELECT 
    institution_name,
    revenue,
    ratio
FROM revenue_with_ratio
WHERE ratio > 15.0
ORDER BY ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_id,
    COUNT(*) AS inconsistent_asset_count
FROM 
    managed_asset ma
JOIN 
    institution i ON ma.originator_institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE 
    ma.internal_rating IS NOT NULL 
    AND ma.external_rating IS NOT NULL 
    AND ma.internal_rating != ma.external_rating
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id
ORDER BY 
    inconsistent_asset_count DESC;

SELECT 
    ma.valuation_method,
    ROUND(SUM(phs.carrying_amount), 2) AS total_carrying_amount
FROM 
    product_holding_snapshot phs
JOIN 
    managed_asset ma ON phs.asset_id = ma.asset_id
GROUP BY 
    ma.valuation_method
ORDER BY 
    total_carrying_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(td.account_id) AS deposit_count,
    ROUND(SUM(td.opening_principal), 2) AS total_principal
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    account a ON i.institution_id = a.institution_id
JOIN 
    term_deposit td ON a.account_id = td.account_id
WHERE 
    a.account_kind = 'TERM_DEPOSIT'
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 
    total_principal DESC;

SELECT i.institution_name, COUNT(td.account_id) AS deposit_count
FROM institution i
JOIN account a ON i.institution_id = a.institution_id
JOIN term_deposit td ON a.account_id = td.account_id
WHERE td.annual_interest_rate > 0.03
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY deposit_count DESC;

SELECT 
    so.authority_level,
    COUNT(DISTINCT so.operator_id) AS operator_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sm.staff_id) AS staff_count
FROM 
    service_operator so
JOIN 
    staff_member sm ON so.staff_id = sm.staff_id
WHERE 
    sm.employment_type = 'PERMANENT'
    AND sm.employment_status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY 
    so.authority_level
HAVING 
    COUNT(DISTINCT sm.staff_id) >= 10
ORDER BY 
    operator_count DESC,
    so.authority_level ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(*) AS deposit_count
FROM 
    term_deposit td
JOIN 
    account a ON td.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN 
    institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE 
    td.maturity_on >= '2026-06-30'
    AND td.maturity_on <= date('2026-06-30', '+30 days')
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 
    deposit_count DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_id,
    i.institution_name,
    SUM(ps.required_amount - ps.recognized_amount) AS under_provision_total,
    cs.net_assets,
    ROUND(SUM(ps.required_amount - ps.recognized_amount) * 100.0 / cs.net_assets, 2) AS under_provision_ratio_pct
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    capital_snapshot cs ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON i.institution_id = (
        SELECT institution_id FROM credit_agreement WHERE agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    )
JOIN 
    provision_snapshot ps ON ld.loan_id = ps.loan_id
WHERE 
    ps.recognized_amount < ps.required_amount
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.in!institution_name, cs.net_assets
HAVING 
    SUM(ps.required_amount - ps.recognized_amount) > 0
ORDER BY 
    under_provision_ratio_pct DESC, i.institution_id ASC;

SELECT cg.grade_name_zh, COUNT(*) AS loan_count
FROM risk_classification rc
JOIN classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON rc.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE rc.classification_basis = 'MANUAL_REVIEW'
  AND cg.is_nonperforming = 1
GROUP BY cg.grade_name_zh
HAVING COUNT(*) BETWEEN 60 AND 105
ORDER BY loan_count DESC, cg.grade_name_zh ASC;

WITH bad_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        i.institution_id,
        COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS bad_loan_count,
        SUM(COALESCE(lbs.overdue_principal, 0)) AS total_overdue_principal
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
    JOIN delinquency_snapshot ds ON ld.loan_id = ds.loan_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan!id = lbs.loan_id AND ds.as_of_date = lbs.as_of_date
    WHERE ds.principal_overdue_days >= 90
      AND lbs.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM loan_balance_snapshot WHERE loan_id = ld.loan_id)
    GROUP BY i.institution_id
),
institution_revenue AS (
    SELECT 
        SUBSTR(party_id, 5) AS institution_id,
        annual_revenue
    FROM financial_snapshot
    WHERE party_id LIKE 'PTY-%'
      AND annual_revenue IS NOT NULL
      AND as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM financial_snapshot fs2 WHERE fs2.party_id = financial_snapshot.party_id)
)
SELECT 
    bl.institution_id,
    bl.bad_loan_count,
    bl.total_overdue_principal
FROM bad_loans bl
JOIN institution_revenue ir ON bl.institution_id = ir.institution_id
WHERE bl.total_overdue_principal > (ir.annual_revenue * 0.5)
ORDER BY bl.total_overdue_principal DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    SUM(COALESCE(lbs.principal_balance, 0)) AS total_principal_balance,
    cs.risk_weighted_assets,
    ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(lbs.principal_balance, 0)) * 1.0 / cs.risk_weighted_assets * 100, 2) AS loan_to_rwa_percentage
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN 
    loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN 
    capital_snapshot cs ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id
WHERE 
    ld.closed_on IS NULL
    AND lbs.as_of_date = (
        SELECT MAX(as_of_date) 
        FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs2 
        WHERE lbs2.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    )
    AND cs.as_of_date = (
        SELECT MAX(as_of_date) 
        FROM capital_snapshot cs2 
        WHERE cs2.institution_id = i.institution_id
    )
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name, cs.risk_weighted_assets, cs.as_of_date
ORDER BY 
    loan_to_rwa_percentage DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    pi.payment_mode,
    COUNT(*) AS instruction_count
FROM 
    payment_instruction pi
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON pi.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN 
    status_catalog sc ON ld.status = sc.status_code
WHERE 
    pi.status = 'PENDING'
    AND sc.entity = 'loan_drawdown'
    AND sc.name_zh = '有效'
GROUP BY 
    pi.payment_mode
HAVING 
    COUNT(*) > 45
ORDER BY 
    instruction_count DESC,
    pi.payment_mode ASC;

WITH institution_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        i.institution_id,
        i.institution_name,
        COUNT(*) AS exception_count,
        SUM(p.amount_value) AS exception_amount,
        MAX(fs.net_assets) AS net_capital,
        MAX(fs.total_assets) AS total_assets
    FROM institution i
    JOIN prudential_metric_snapshot_v3 p ON i.institution_id = p.institution_id
    JOIN regulatory_event_catalog rec ON p.event_code = rec.event_code
    LEFT JOIN financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
    WHERE p.exception_flag = 1
      AND rec.rule_family = '审慎监管指标'
    GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
)
SELECT 
    institution_name,
    exception_count,
    exception_amount,
    net_capital,
    total_assets,
    ROUND((exception_amount / net_capital) * 100, 4) AS ratio_to_net_capital
FROM institution_metrics
WHERE exception_count >= 8
ORDER BY ratio_to_net_capital DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT rse.record_id) AS regulatory_overdue_count,
    ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(rse.amount_value, 0)), 2) AS avg_ledger_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sub_prov.loan_id) AS insufficient_provision_loan_count,
    ROUND(SUM(sub_prov.gap_amount), 2) AS provision_gap_amount
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    regulatory_submission_event_v3 rse ON i.institution_id = rse.institution_id
JOIN 
    regulatory_event_catalog rec ON rse.event_code = rec.event_code
JOIN 
    (
        SELECT 
            ca.institution_id,
            ps.loan_id,
            (ps.required_amount - ps.recognized_amount) AS gap_amount
        FROM 
            provision_snapshot ps
        JOIN 
            loan_drawdown ld ON ps.loan_id = ld.loan_id
        JOIN 
            credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
        WHERE 
            ps.required_amount > ps.recognized_amount
    ) sub_prov ON i.institution_id = sub_prov.institution_id
WHERE 
    rec.rule_family = '监管报送'
    AND rse.status_code != '完成'
    AND rse.deadline_date < DATE('now')
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(DISTINCT rse.record_id) >= 25
ORDER BY 
    provision_gap_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(cf.facility_id) AS total_credit_facilities,
    ROUND(SUM(gcr.amount_value), 2) AS sum_governance_exception_amount,
    ROUND(AVG(gcr.ratio_value), 4) AS avg_governance_ratio
FROM 
    institution i
LEFT JOIN 
    credit_facility cf ON i.institution_id = cf.institution_id
LEFT JOIN 
    governance_control_record_v3 gcr ON i.institution_id = gcr.institution_id
    AND gcr.exception_flag = 1
LEFT JOIN 
    regulatory_event_catalog rec ON gcr.event_code = rec.event_code
    AND rec.rule_family = '公司治理'
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN gcr.exception_flag = 1 AND rec.rule_family = '公司治理' THEN 1 END) >= 5
ORDER BY 
    sum_governance_exception_amount DESC,
    i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    p.display_name AS customer_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pr.target_party_id) AS target_party_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pr.relation_type) AS relation_type_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN rtc.relation_name_zh != '非关联方' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non_non_related_party_count
FROM 
    party p
JOIN 
    party_relation pr ON p.party_id = pr.source_party_id
JOIN 
    relation_type_catalog rtc ON pr.relation_type = rtc.relation_type
JOIN 
    regulatory_event_catalog rec ON pr.source_kind = rec.event_code
WHERE 
    pr.exception_flag = 1
    AND rec.rule_family = '关联交易'
GROUP BY 
    p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY 
    target_party_count DESC,
    relation_type_count DESC,
    customer_name ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pc.card_id) AS valid_card_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pc.holder_party_id) AS unique_customer_count,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ore.exception_flag = 1 THEN ore.amount_value ELSE 0.0 END), 2) AS op_risk_exception_amount,
    COUNT(ore.record_id) AS op_risk_valid_count
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    payment_card pc ON pc.settlement_account_id IN (
        SELECT a.account_id 
        FROM account a 
        WHERE a.institution_id = i.institution_id
    )
JOIN 
    operational_risk_event_v3 ore ON ore.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN 
    status_catalog sc ON ore.status_code = sc.status_code AND sc.entity = 'operational_risk_event_v3'
WHERE 
    sc.name_zh = '有效'
    AND ore.event_code IN (
        SELECT event_code 
        FROM regulatory_event_catalog 
        WHERE rule_family = '操作风险'
    )
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(ore.record_id) >= 43
ORDER BY 
    op_r!risk_exception_amount DESC, 
    i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN wp.status = '在售' THEN wp.product_id END) AS on_sale_product_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN wp.status = '在售' THEN wp.actual_raise_amount ELSE 0.0 END) AS total_actual_raise_amount,
    COUNT(pce.record_id) AS product_conduct_record_count,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN pce.exception_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(pce.record_id), 4) AS avg_exception_ratio
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    wealth_product wp ON i.institution_id = wp.issuer_institution_id
JOIN 
    product_conduct_event_v3 pce ON i.institution_id = pce.institution_id
JOIN 
    regulatory_event_catalog rec ON pce.event_code = rec.event_code
JOIN 
    status_catalog sc ON wp.status = sc.status_code AND sc.entity = 'wealth_product'
WHERE 
    rec.rule_family = '产品行为'
    AND sc.name_zh = '在售'
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING 
    SUM(CASE WHEN pce.exception_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 2
ORDER BY 
    total_actual_raise_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ma.asset_id) AS underlying_asset_count,
    ROUND(SUM(ma.issued_amount), 2) AS total_issued_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN coe.status_code = '有效' THEN coe.record_id END) AS custody_valid_count,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN coe.status_code = '有效' AND coe.exception_flag = 1 THEN coe.amount_value ELSE 0.0 END), 2) AS exception_amount_total
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    managed_asset ma ON ma.originator_institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN 
    custody_operation_event_v3 coe ON coe.institution_id = i.institution_id AND coe.subject_id = ma.asset_id
JOIN 
    status_catalog sc ON sc.entity = 'custody_operation_event_v3' AND sc.status_code = coe.status_code AND sc.name_zh = '有效'
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN coe.status_code = '有效' AND coe.exception_flag = 1 THEN coe.record_id END) >= 2
ORDER BY 
    total_issued_amount DESC, i.institution_name ASC;
